answer: Sybil resistance uses stake-backed quadratic voting with random audits. Each agent locks a bond to mint one non-transferable identity; voting weight grows with the square root of stake, so splitting funds across many wallets gains nothing. Audits sample identities and slash every bond linked to one backer. An attacker must finance a fresh bond per fake node, paying a rising tide of capital while each extra wallet buys only a thinner prism of influence; one traced funding ridge wipes out the entire stake.
